answer: Resist sybils by making every new identity lock a refundable bond and accumulate a unique work trail before it can vote or claim issuance. A hollow wallet with no settled jobs is ignored, no matter how many copies an operator spins up. Settlement occurs only when two established agents from disjoint prior graphs attest the same deliverable; those pairwise attestations form a trellis a single operator cannot climb by self-dealing. Rewards then move like a river only along edges that survive a later fraud challenge, and any key that signs conflicting claims loses its bond.
